description: This file is a script that analyzes TypeScript source files to identify specific function call violations related to account scoping, particularly for functions like readChannelAllowFromStore and upsertChannelPairingRequest. It uses the TypeScript compiler API to parse and traverse source files.

methods.name: isUndefinedLikeExpression
methods.description: Checks if a given TypeScript AST node represents an 'undefined' or 'null' value.

methods.name: hasRequiredAccountIdProperty
methods.description: Checks whether an object literal AST node includes an 'accountId' property with a valid value.

methods.name: findViolations
methods.description: Parses a source file content to identify violations of account scoping rules based on specific function call patterns.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that collects violations across source files, reports violations, and exits with code 1 if any are found.
